about: Questions a maintenance engineer could ask of FAA AC 43.13-1B (with Change 1). Each lists the PDF page(s) that actually answer it, checked against the extracted text of the file fetched by scripts/fetch_sample_docs.ps1. 'pages' are PDF file page numbers (what a PDF viewer calls page N); 'labels' are the page numbers printed on those pages, for humans. A retrieved chunk counts as a hit when it comes from one of these pages. 'off_topic' questions have no answer in the manual and must be refused.
